save.text: Giveaway at 4,200 subs won by LL1973: signed 5e Player's Handbook + cast photo; new giveaways every +50 subs (next at 4,250).
No Critical Role next week due to SDCC; panels Thursday at Petco Park: Geek & Sundry panel 1–2 pm (Matt, Laura) and Critical Role panel 4–5 pm; no badge needed; filmed and streamed next day.
Following week Matt and Marisha in New Zealand for Armageddon; two weeks without main-story; remaining cast will stream alternative content.
Intro video malfunction; they decide to skip it and start the game live; Orion was Periscoping, thought they weren’t live; crew confirms they’re on camera.

Sam arrives late during Matt’s recap; story currently: Vox Machina escorting indestructible Horn of Orcus to Vasselheim via skyship after Underdark; attacked by wyvern/griffon riders, took a captive; journey ~6–7 days.
Cast does playful Brady Bunch-style camera bit; Ashley wants to show a guest at break, not now.
Captured halfling mage from attacker group is bound; Captain Damon locked her in ship’s anti-magic brig, not hiring her; fate pending.
Several uneventful travel days pass over the Ozmit Sea; party fully rested with spells returned; nearing destination to be addressed by Matt.
Grog’s magical beard growth progresses to translucent stubble (~1–1.5 in); Keyleth braids it with beads/flowers; Vax later glues frayed-rope goatee onto sleeping Grog.
Grog’s beard prank resolved: now a dark brown, well-braided goatee ~3–4 inches; Grog proud; prior rope-goatee gag effectively replaced.
Day 6 mid-journey: weather shifts to cold, gloomy cloud cover; Keyleth Nature check 20 confirms natural northern climate, not arcane.
Tiberius persuades Scanlan to trade items: Scanlan agrees to swap his circlet/crown for Tiberius’s Ioun Stone after debate and chalk talk.
Trade finalized: Scanlan swaps his circlet/crown for Tiberius’s Ioun Stone; stone now orbits Scanlan’s head; party praises the deal.
Approaching Vasselheim: temperature drops; specks of snow begin; aligns with prior natural climate note.

Keyleth reveals Fire Ashari live near Vasselheim in Pyrah; as part of her Aramente she must meet elemental tribe headmasters; proposes visiting after Horn delivery; party agrees to support her leadership image.

Approaching Vasselheim confirmed: landfall at Othanzia; Vesper Timberland noted; visible snowfall; city extremely fortified with layered ancient-to-modern walls and dragon-headed ballistae; larger than Emon.
Keyleth shares personal backstory: her mother left when K was ~5–6; unknown tribe, status unknown; K is next in line. Party plans to visit Pyrah/Fire Ashari and may ask about her mother.
Kima welcomes them to Othanzia; advises Vesper Timberland leads to tundra north; suggests avoiding long northern travel.
First visit to Vasselheim for party members present; short rest confirmed during approach.
Approach/landing at Vasselheim: ancient city with repeatedly damaged/rebuilt walls; ad‑hoc mill-top platform not built for skyships; cold climate—need warmer clothes outside city.
Scanlan stores a 3rd‑level Lightning Bolt in the Ioun Stone (still white stone; glow appears greenish-blue).
Kima hasn’t been with her Order properly for eight years; she seems nervous but not deceptive.
Scalebearer Yonn (elderly, bald, spectacles) leads escorts; Platinum Sanctuary is ~25-minute walk; plan is to move the Horn discreetly—only Yonn, Vox Machina, and Highbearer Vord knew prior.
Vasselheim bars regular arcane practice; no arcane temples/sigils; city is a divine/holy place.
Vasselheim culture: cradle of faith; entry by foot as pilgrimage; guards display holy symbols (Arathis, Avandra, Melora, some Bahamut); no Sarenrae seen.

Escort formation decided: Keyleth in eagle form for aerial support; Vex on rooftops (rolled 1, conspicuous); Vax blending with crowd (stealth 23); Grog/Pike on path; Tiberius takes rear; plan to surround the box.
Scalebearer Yonn uneasy with dragonborn; accepts due to Bahamut faith; warns Tiberius not to cast Alter Self openly; Tiberius altered to gold briefly.
Vasselheim ethos: oldest holy city; harsh living seen as devotional privilege; arcane considered profane in public and tightly controlled.
Escort continues with guards flanking; carrying ornate platinum/silver box (~1.5–2 ft square) with sapphires; draws notice but no gawking; option to cover with cloth discussed.

Arrival/approach: ascent of long stair (15–20 min) to Platinum Sanctuary on mountain; fortress ancient with Draconic inscriptions (“honor, justice”); three ivory-silver spires; Bahamut symbol on great doors.
Vasselheim: civilian militia Bastions (volunteer), about a quarter of populace; envoys are Bahamut temple in blue/silver robes; ballistas on walls.
Ascent views: dense ominous forest around Vasselheim; moving trees; ballistas engage large fast multi-serpentine creature near walls; common occurrence.
Escort/entry: party entered Platinum Sanctuary; Keyleth briefly scouted as eagle outside; Percy/Vax nearly got shut out but made it in; interior has arrow slits, not windows.
Keyleth was detained and cuffed by Scalebearers in the Platinum Sanctuary but immediately released when Lady Kima vouched for her; guards apologized and left.
Inside Platinum Sanctuary: ancient, plain stone fortress humming with divine power; Pike senses exceptionally strong holiness (jokes rate it 6/5).
Kima admonished party to avoid fraternizing in Bahamut’s temple while being led by Scalebearer Yonn.

Platinum Sanctuary central dome chamber: 80-ft dome with ancient mural of creation; planes depicted incl. Astral, Nine Hells, Abyss; Bahamut fighting Tiamat; Yonn opens doors with glowing holy symbol.
Party learns Tiamat is very much still around; Yonn, Kima, and Scalebearers’ silent confirmation; Tiberius affirms.

Highbearer Vord (elder elf, Keeper) greets party; Kima kneels as his disciple. He confirms the boxed item is a true Horn of Orcus via divine pulse, says it must be sealed immediately; orders not to open it.
Plan: Escort Horn to Hall of the Exalt beneath temple; clear foul subterranean spiders; Yonn triggered some vault defenses while fleeing; party must contend with partial defenses.
Vault logistics: Scalebearers will carry the boxed Horn with the party during descent; party must keep them safe.

Star of Exaltation lore: Bahamut’s tear-born crystal; created in the Dawn War; used 300 years ago in a siege of Vasselheim as divine focus, expending its power and destroyed/removed from plane; chamber remains intact and maintained.
Immediate plan affirmed: escort Scalebearers and Horn now to Hall of the Exalt; Highbearer urges immediate sealing; party proceeds at once.
Temple offers 3,000 gp total reward upon successful sealing; Scanlan persuades with Deception 30; Kima initially objects; payout after delivery.
Kima accompanies party to vault; leads them down into musty storage levels within mountain toward vault room.
Vault access: Kima uses her holy symbol in hidden recess; illusory wood dispels to stone doorway and stairs; she admits she’s never been in the vault.

Vault first chamber: 50x50 ft, 20-ft high; thick white mist generated from dragon-mouth pillars; pillars have slight gap at bases suggesting rotation/pivot; mist refills quickly; low sconces; Keyleth’s Gust of Wind can clear center briefly; bright Light worsens visibility.
Party at stairway debating mist: Percy dons mask; Keyleth maintains Gust of Wind up to 1 minute; discussion of testing mist; Tiberius reassigns earrings to Vax, Grog, Scanlan (Vex loses hers).

Mist trap triggered when Vax brushed mist at wall; dragon-mouth pillars erupted spinning flames; saves: Vax evaded (Uncanny Dodge/evade), Tiberius 12 dmg, Scanlan/Keyleth/Pike 24 dmg; group briefly split until Keyleth spent 2nd Gust to clear again.

Vault first chamber: 50x50 ft, 20-ft high; thick white mist from dragon-mouth pillars; touching mist triggers spinning flame burst trap; pillars have slight base gap; Gust of Wind can clear center briefly; bright Light worsens visibility.
Correction: Vax took 0 dmg on successful save; Tiberius took 12; Scanlan, Keyleth, Pike took 24; party reunited after second Gust within a minute.
Vault room 1: Mist chamber resets when they exit; Orion’s light shield only covers eyes; party crosses; room fully obfuscated again.

Vault room 2: Circular cylinder chamber with floor of many marked circles; stepping a circle triggers rotating room and pistoning floor pillars slamming into ceiling; exit is a wide 20-ft descending staircase opposite.
Vax tests a circle using Boots of Haste; survives with Nat 20 save but is struck by pillar for 40 crushing dmg; acrobatics/saves required to traverse.
Vax reaches staircase through rotating piston room, badly bruised (possible broken ribs). Spots a coin-sized hole in ceiling revealed when central pillar retracts.

Vault room 2 update: Rotating grinding mill with pistoning pillars; coin-sized hole in ceiling appears where central pillar hits. Vex, with Bardic Inspiration, makes a 35 attack to ricochet an arrow toward it; Tiberius attempts Telekinesis on the shot.
Enhance Ability won’t help attacks; Bardic Inspiration d10 used on Vex’s shot. Grog’s fake rope beard comes off; Vex keeps it as Fake Grog Rope Beard.
Vex’s ricochet arrow succeeds; Orion’s Telekinesis aids with a +5 d20 (rolled 17). The impact jams the mechanism: splintering wood/metal, debris pours out, pillars grind to a halt.
After crossing, party takes a short rest; Vax spends hit dice to heal; break called with hard stop at 10 pm; charity/T-shirts mentioned during break.
Bardic Inspiration d10 used on Vex’s ‘near-impossible’ shot; Enhance Ability doesn’t help attacks; Grog’s fake rope beard kept by Vex as ‘Fake Grog Rope Beard.’
On-air charity segment: Guest Taylor from GameChanger Charity explains mission; partnership with Deus Ex promo; website: gamechangercharity.org.
Donation plan: Cast decides all donations tonight (portion normally to 826LA) will go to GameChanger; link via 826LA button routes funds to GameChanger for tonight.
Promo specifics: Donate >$1 via GameChanger campaign to get Deus Ex: Director’s Cut; last day of the promo; site briefly crashed from traffic.
